correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the analytic all-index proof in RESULT.md. The complementary stationary/centered projections give M_n=Π+z_n(I−Π), with unit row sums, off-diagonal sign set by 1−z_n, and diagonal lower condition z_n≥−min(a,b)/max(a,b). For 0<r<1/2 the real roots are (2∓√(1−2r))^−1 and the stated BE-started coefficients have the larger-root coefficient exceeding the subtracted one by one; thus z_n>0. At r=1/2 the repeated-root solution is 2^−n(1+n/3)>0. The first-difference recurrence then proves strict decrease in this regime. For r>1/2, matching z₀ and z₁ gives the stated trigonometric solution. Using |sin(nθ)|≤n sinθ bounds |z_n| by 2^−n(1+n/3), hence z_n<1 for n≥1 and |z_n|≤5/192 for n≥7. Independently checked the shifted polynomials from the recurrence and the four quadratic discriminants (−1843840, −101573568, −5495631872, −124090302464 in index order). The split about t=2 for P₃ and the positive higher coefficients in P₄–P₆ give strict positivity, so z₃,…,z₆>−29/1000>−(17−12√2). For n=2 the rational derivative has its only positive zero at r=3+3√2, a strict minimum with z₂=−(17−12√2); n=0,1 cannot tie. Reciprocating proves the claimed rate boundary and its unique normalized equality step for one diagonal. For fixed positive rates the real-root regime is safe and the complex-root bound also gives uniform |z_n|≤5/[3(3+2r)] for n≥2 as r→∞; z₁→0 separately. The exact 40:1 witness has r=7 and z₂=−1/34, hence (M₂)₁₁=−3/697. Inspected VERIFICATION.md, verify.py and the recorded output; did not execute the uploaded script. Its checks are finite support, not the all-index proof. Scope is constant step, irreducible two-state row generator, BE startup from one initial law and exact arithmetic.

value.rationale: The sharp rate-ratio criterion answers a natural question not resolved by generic step restrictions: can a standard BE-started integrator preserve every initial probability for every step on the simplest irreducible exchange? It shows how a signed centered mode is compatible with positivity because of the stationary mass, gives an exact obstruction at the second step, and distinguishes intermediate failures from eventual large-step safety. This is an exact model-specific invariant and explanation, not a claim for general Markov generators.
